name: Happy Scribe
tagline: Transcription, subtitles, and AI meeting notes in 150+ languages.
description: A transcription and subtitling platform that turns calls, interviews, and recordings into accurate, searchable text. It offers instant AI transcription, a professional human transcriber network for 99%+ accuracy, automatic subtitles and translation across 150+ languages, and an AI notetaker that joins Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom calls.
insight: Bootstrapped since 2017, founded by two Dublin City University students after a class assignment to transcribe research interviews.
edge: Offers both instant AI transcription and a professional human transcriber network (99%+ accuracy) in 150+ languages, side by side.
pros: AI and human transcription side by side
AI notetaker for Meet, Teams, and Zoom
SOC 2 Type II with EU data residency
cons: Human transcription costs more and is slower
AI accuracy varies with audio quality

references.title: How Andre Bastie Is Scaling Happy Scribe After Instant Product-Market Fit
